description: USE WHEN you want multi-year wealth paths for a savings plan or a withdrawal plan. Distribution of multi-year wealth paths for a savings plan (monthly_contribution) or a withdrawal plan (monthly_withdrawal, inflation-indexed by default) on a SPY/TLT/GOLD/BTC portfolio. Multi-year paths chain ~2y model blocks (block-bootstrap); long-run drift is RE-ANCHORED to stated round-number assumptions (overridable via long_run_drift; see assumptions.long_run_drift) while the model's path shape is kept; both are echoed. Costs are ON by default. Returns terminal-wealth quantiles (nominal + real), ruin/shortfall probabilities, a sequence-of-returns diagnosis and a drift sensitivity (assumptions - 2pp). Descriptive, not advisory; no rate, allocation or product is recommended.

annual_inflation.description: Annual inflation assumption for indexing and real-value reporting (fraction, default 0.02).
annual_inflation.title: Annual Inflation

holdings.description: Portfolio legs: list of {asset, weight} objects, e.g. [{'asset': 'SPY', 'weight': 0.6}, {'asset': 'TLT', 'weight': 0.4}]. Assets: SPY, TLT, GOLD, BTC (aliases GLD, BTC-USD). Weights are non-negative and normalised to sum to 1; at most 50 legs, no duplicates.
holdings.title: Holdings

horizon_years.description: Plan horizon in years (multi-year paths are chained from ~2-year model blocks).
horizon_years.title: Horizon Years

long_run_drift.description: Override the re-anchored long-run drift per asset: {ASSET: annual drift fraction}; omit for the stated round-number assumptions (assumptions.long_run_drift in the response).
long_run_drift.title: Long Run Drift

monthly_withdrawal.description: Monthly withdrawal (withdrawal-plan mode); inflation-indexed when withdrawal_inflation_indexed is true.
monthly_withdrawal.title: Monthly Withdrawal

target_amount.description: Optional wealth target; the output reports the probability of reaching it.
target_amount.title: Target Amount

withdrawal_inflation_indexed.description: Index the monthly withdrawal to inflation.
withdrawal_inflation_indexed.title: Withdrawal Inflation Indexed

name: long_horizon_stress
title: Long-horizon wealth-path stress (savings / withdrawal plans)
